definitions: A period of 365 days (or 366 in a leap year), starting from 1 January and ending on 31 December.
A period of twelve months from any specified date, or between specified limits.
A period of time used for administrative or educational purposes, often not coinciding with the calendar year.
A group of students of the same age or who started a course at the same time.
examples: She's been working here for a year.
The academic year begins in September.
He's in his final year at university.
